A_hard_runtime_provenance_set_coherence.mechanism: HardRuntimeGate requires every decision-driving fact-binding claim to be contained in HardRuntimeEvidence.book2_claim_refs; the assessment's actual authority set can no longer differ from its declared provenance set

B_hard_runtime_context_binding.mechanism: HardRuntimeFactContextBinding binds each fact claim to the exact consumer, provider, function, and scope; binding context must equal the record context, and the canonical claim proposition must bind the assessed consumer (subject_refs) and provider (object_ref). Function and scope have no Book 2 Proposition dimension and are validated only as typed Book 4 binding dimensions, which is documented rather than treated as proven.

C_failure_domain_pair_scope.mechanism: FailureDomainBook.classify requires IndependenceClaimBinding records whose domain, system, and correlation-scope dimensions equal the assessed left/right pair, and whose canonical POSITIVE_INDEPENDENCE claim proposition binds the left/right systems; an independence claim for X/Y can never classify A/B. Shared-mechanism classification still dominates.

D_redundancy_context_binding.mechanism: RedundancyAssessment requires IndependenceClaimBinding coverage exactly equal to positive_independence_claim_refs; RedundancyBook validates that each binding names the assessed subject, provider pair, and function, so a claim for providers X/Y or another function can never support INDEPENDENT_REDUNDANCY

E_nested_claim_set_coherence.mechanism: require_claim_set_closure enforces nested decision-driving claims to be a subset of the record-level book2_claim_refs for HardRuntimeEvidence fact bindings, FailureDomain.mechanism_claim_refs, and RedundancyAssessment.positive_independence_claim_refs; referenced FailureDomain objects keep their own canonical provenance and are deliberately excluded from the redundancy closure
E_nested_claim_set_coherence.direct_assessment_evidence: nested claims must sit inside the owning record's declared provenance
E_nested_claim_set_coherence.referenced_object_evidence: FailureDomain objects referenced by redundancy records keep their own canonical provenance

F_snapshot_exact_lineage.mechanism: Book4Provenance.validate_snapshot_lineage now requires set equality between source_snapshot_refs and the raw_snapshot_ref values reachable from the record's canonical Book 2 claims: missing snapshots and unrelated extra snapshots are both rejected; deduplication follows from set equality; no second snapshot registry exists
F_snapshot_exact_lineage.known_limitation: Book 2 exposes snapshot identity only through RawEvidence.raw_snapshot_ref, so exact reachable-set equality remains the narrowest valid check without mutating accepted Books 1-3
